why_best: It highlights the active selection with full visual prominence while neatly consolidating historical options into a constant, non-intrusive footprint.
why_bad: Allowing new panels to simply push older ones sideways off the stage would destroy the visual history and crowd out the presenter.
trap: An imprecise build will linearly offset each tucked panel by a fixed distance instead of dynamically recalculating their shared compression inside the bounded footprint.
